notes: Portable 2025 public-API acceptance evidence for Annex C.3 matching named data-type declarations. Two adapter-owned, schema-valid DIF modules independently declare identical basic, simple, reference, enumerated, array, fixed-record, variant-record, and extendable-variant-record types. Each module is accepted alone, then the pair is accepted in one Create Federation Execution call. Native focused CTest passed 1/1; installed-package CTest and direct runner passed 4/4 each across both callback models; Java compiled against the API-only JAR. C++ and Java use only the official RTI ambassador APIs. The public API does not expose the merged private data-type catalog, so structural retention remains native internal evidence rather than a portable assertion. Java provider runtime, interoperability, and conformance are unverified.
